content.concept_description: A relaxing showcase of a block-sliding puzzle game emphasizing stress-free gameplay with no timers, featuring handcrafted levels and satisfying piece clears.
content.why_it_works: Contrasting stressful timed mobile games with a relaxing, un-timed puzzle experience appeals strongly to casual players seeking satisfying mental stimulation without anxiety.

visuals.primary_color: Dominant deep blue (#002244, #19488a) with vibrant primary block accents in red (#e53935), green (#43a047), orange (#fb8c00), and sky blue (#039be5)
visuals.notable_objects: Pegged puzzle blocks, flaming pocket watch, animated hand pointer

end_card.cta_and_text: 00:56 - 'BLOCK BUSTER' logo and 'PLAY NOW!' CTA button

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Players slide textured, multi-square block shapes across a gridded board to line them up with matching color-coded exit gates along the perimeter.

chapterization.chapter_description: Prominent 'No Timer!' text introduces smooth block-clearing gameplay.
Hand cursor slides blocks across the board into matching exit portals, emphasizing relaxed pacing.
A 9-grid view showcases level variety before a cinematic clock burns away and gameplay resumes at a faster solve rate.
Simultaneous clearance of multiple puzzle boards bursting into block particles.
Animated finger taps the 'PLAY NOW!' button underneath the Block Buster logo.
